messages:
Anna: Heads-up — after the canary routing change we see orphaned chunk metering for some streaming sessions, UI shows fewer tokens than the ledger. Repro on prod canary. :eyes:
Devon: hmm, can you paste a sample trace id?
Anna: trace=abc123-prod, router=canary-v2, logs: 
Anna: ```
[2026-03-22T15:12:03Z] session=abc123 received chunk offset=0
[2026-03-22T15:12:04Z] session=abc123 handoff route=stable -> canary-v2
[2026-03-22T15:12:05Z] session=abc123 chunk-acked prefix=... ledger-tag=null
```
Rahul: this looks like the metering tag wasn't attached on handoff. suspect route_id header dropped in handoff path. :thinking:
Maria: can you run this query on dev cluster to find similar sessions?
Maria: ```sql
SELECT session_id, count(*) as chunks, max(route) FROM stream_chunks WHERE timestamp=\'2026-03-22\' GROUP BY session_id HAVING max(route)=\'canary-v2\' AND sum(case when ledger_tag IS NULL then 1 else 0 end)>0;
```
Devon: also seeing retry bursts — maybe retries created ephemeral toolcalls with no ledger tag. see toolcall id tc-77 in traces.
Anna: ops-bot alerted: \"metering-sla: orphaned-chunk-rate spike 8% over baseline\"
ops-bot: incident created #INC-7654
Rahul: quick fix options: 1) patch handoff to copy route_id into metering header; 2) fallback: treat null tag as previous route; 3) rollback canary. I'm +1 for patch then continue canary.
Maria: agree, but need dashboard tweak to surface sessions with null ledger_tag. I'll add a graph and an alert.
Devon: small patch PR planned: `router/handshake: copy X-Route-ID -> X-Meter-Route` I can open.
Anna: assign to Devon, canary paused. I'll update console note and support channel. :thumbsup:
Devon: opened PR #4523 — tests included. diff snippet:
Devon: ```go
if hdr := req.Header.Get(\"X-Route-ID\"); hdr != \"\" {
 req.Header.Set(\"X-Meter-Route\", hdr)
}
```
Rahul: add unit for retry path too — retries go via proxy which strips headers sometimes.
Devon: will add the proxy path test and a small integration.
Maria: created dashboard panel \"orphaned_chunks_by_route\" and alert threshold 1%. linked to #INC-7654.
Anna: timeline: patch -> canary restart -> monitor 30m -> unpause if metrics normalize. Anyone object?
Rahul: no objections. I'll watch the ledger reconciliation job and run the SQL across last 48h.
Anna: thanks team, keeping this thread for postmortem notes. :sparkles:
